content: {"praised":["High production quality with movie‑like visuals and sound.","Stunning fight choreography reminiscent of Kill Bill and Matrix.","Strong character development and compelling twists.","Excellent acting and well‑crafted performances.","Blend of sci‑fi, fantasy, mysticism, romance."],"criticized":["Excessive violence and graphic opening scene.","Too much gore makes it uncomfortable.","Some plot ideas feel simple, like Hunger Games.","Limited to only six episodes.","Over‑the‑top fighting may feel excessive."]}
